old_string:
if Humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0 then
			local WalkSpeed = Humanoid.WalkSpeed
			Humanoid.WalkSpeed = 0

			task.delay(.01, function() Humanoid.WalkSpeed = WalkSpeed end)
		end
new_string:
-- re-kick the walk track: speed 0 for a frame, then the real speed back. (1.97.1) Shared with AnimationController
		-- through the NHKickSpeed attribute: a second kick in the same frame used to read the first one's 0 and put 0
		-- back (frozen until sprint). Only the first kick zeroes; the restore only applies if the speed is still 0.
		if Humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0 and Humanoid:GetAttribute(`NHKickSpeed`) == nil then
			Humanoid:SetAttribute(`NHKickSpeed`, Humanoid.WalkSpeed)
			Humanoid.WalkSpeed = 0

			task.delay(.01, function()
				local Back = Humanoid:GetAttribute(`NHKickSpeed`)
				Humanoid:SetAttribute(`NHKickSpeed`, nil)
				if Back and Humanoid.WalkSpeed == 0 then Humanoid.WalkSpeed = Back end
			end)
		end
